note: Committed BEFORE any model evaluation was run. Thresholds below may not be changed after results are seen; any change must be a new version with a logged reason.
data_scope: 2026-27 regular season games 2026-10-20..2026-11-01 (92 games, official nba.com scoreboard pages) + official 2025-26 team tables.

targets.margin: home points - away points; error metric = MAE (points)
targets.total: home points + away points; error metric = MAE (points)
targets.win: home team wins; probability metric = Brier score
targets.parlay: 2-leg same-game parlay (favourite wins AND total over own line); probability metric = Brier score

walk_forward_rule: A prediction for a game on date D may use only games with date < D (strictly earlier; same-day games excluded) plus the official 2025-26 tables. Parameters are either declared a priori or tuned only on games that precede the evaluation window.

bootstrap.multiple_testing: Bonferroni across the m non-baseline testable strategies in the catalogue: CI level = 1 - 0.05/m (two-sided). The single pre-declared primary strategies (BLEND-41 margin and total) are also reported at plain 95%.

gates.name: Provenance
gates.rule: Every input comes from an official nba.com page with a source_url in the data row, and scripts/verify_data.py passes.

gates.name: Walk-forward / no look-ahead
gates.rule: Evaluation code obeys walk_forward_rule (asserted in code).

gates.name: Sample size
gates.rule: At least 300 out-of-sample evaluated games (probability targets: 300 games after the first 30 games of the season).

gates.name: Significance vs strongest baseline
gates.rule: Lower bound of the bootstrap CI of (baseline error - strategy error) is > 0 (for Brier targets: baseline Brier - strategy Brier).

gates.name: Calibration
gates.rule: Probability targets: strategy Brier <= baseline Brier AND |mean predicted - observed rate| <= 0.05. Point-forecast targets: |mean signed error| <= 1.5 points.

gates.name: Market edge / closing-line value
gates.rule: Beats an OFFICIAL closing market price out of sample. No official odds source is available to this project; this gate is 'not testable' and earns 0.

gates.name: Stability
gates.rule: Error improvement vs baseline has the same sign in both chronological halves of the evaluation sample.

tiers.Forecast-validated: G3 and G4 pass and total score >= 60. Eligible for a virtual reward.
tiers.Betting-validated: Forecast-validated AND G6 pass. Only these may ever be staked with real money. (None can exist until an official odds source is added.)
tiers.Provisional: G1, G2 pass and point estimate beats baseline but G3 or G4 fails: monitored, reward = 0. Outcome is indistinguishable from luck at this sample size.
tiers.Rejected: G1 or G2 fails, or the point estimate does not beat the baseline.
tiers.Blocked: Required data is not available from an official source; not evaluated, reward = 0.

reward_rule: Virtual pool of 1000 stake units (NOT real money). Split pro rata to total gate score among Forecast-validated strategies only; Betting-validated strategies get x2 weight. If no strategy qualifies the pool is unallocated (0 for everyone). Baselines are never rewarded.

catalogue.definition: margin = H (mean 2025-26 home +/-), no team information
total = league-average total so far (2025-26 PTS/g x2 before the first game)
P(home wins) = 2025-26 home win rate (home W / home GP)
joint probability = product of leg probabilities (independence)
margin = R25_home - R25_away + H, R = 2025-26 +/- per game
margin = R26_home - R26_away + H with R26 = season-to-date margin per game (0 with no games)
R = (n*R26 + 41*R25)/(n+41), n = games played; margin = R_home - R_away + H. k=41 declared a priori (half of an 82-game season).
total = O_home + D_away + O_away + D_home - 2L with O = points for, D = points against per game, blended with k=41 as above; L = league mean points per team per game
P(home wins) = Phi(margin / sigma), sigma = expanding-window SD of residuals of BLEND-41 (needs >= 30 earlier games)
joint probability from a bivariate normal with correlation estimated on earlier games (margin vs total residual)

catalogue.reason: no official bulk player game-log source retrieved
no official player game logs and no official prop lines

sensitivity_and_robustness: k in {0,10,20,41,60,82,1000} reported for BLEND margin, labelled exploratory and NOT used for ranking. A nested check tunes k on games through 2026-10-26 and evaluates on later games.
